build_side_effects_tracker: build a SideEffects instance to track list mutations and attribute changes after FX graph execution
clone_side_effects: clone a SideEffects object to create a shallow copy for use in nested graph compilation contexts
track_object_mutation: track object attribute mutations using track_object_existing or track_object_new on a SideEffects instance
codegen_update_mutated: codegen the deferred mutation instructions for list slices, dicts, attributes, and iterators after graph generation
diff_side_effects: diff two SideEffects objects to identify differences in tracked variables and attribute mutations for debugging
